sealed_record.thesis: Phison's CEO flags 2027 NAND capacity constraints as more severe than 2026, with 4-year lead times from plant construction to production against explosively growing demand. Micron is a core NAND/DRAM player not caught in the crowded SNDK/SKHY trade the market is already piling into, giving a cleaner entry into the same structural shortage. The consensus 'memory is over' narrative is fighting a multi-year supply/demand imbalance the supply side physically cannot close before 2027.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -29.3%. Ditutup dalam AI trade unwind: skandal dan pencopotan Jensen Huang (8 Nov), aturan sementara ekspor chip AI dari Departemen Perdagangan AS (16 Nov). Long AI/semikonduktor 0 dari 12 untung.
